criteria.lift-bottom: {"id":"lift-bottom","sequence":"F2","position":"DF","yellowDirection":"D","purpose":"Target at DF with yellow pointing D: F2 lifts it to UF yellow-up. Before lifting, UF should not contain an existing yellow-up petal.","requiredFreeSlots":["UF"],"affectedBottomSlots":["DF"]}
criteria.lift-middle-right: {"id":"lift-middle-right","sequence":"R","position":"FR","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at FR with yellow pointing F: R lifts it to UR yellow-up. Before lifting, UR should not contain an existing yellow-up petal.","requiredFreeSlots":["UR"],"affectedBottomSlots":["DR"]}
criteria.lift-middle-left: {"id":"lift-middle-left","sequence":"L'","position":"FL","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at FL with yellow pointing F: L-prime lifts it to UL yellow-up. Before lifting, UL should not contain an existing yellow-up petal.","requiredFreeSlots":["UL"],"affectedBottomSlots":["DL"]}
criteria.stage-bottom-edge: {"id":"stage-bottom-edge","sequence":"F","position":"DF","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at DF with yellow pointing F: F moves it to FL with yellow still pointing F. Requires UF free of yellow-up petals. This stages the edge in the middle, not yet a petal. On a later decision, clear UL and use lift-middle-left.","requiredFreeSlots":["UF"],"affectedBottomSlots":["DF"]}
criteria.flip-top-edge: {"id":"flip-top-edge","sequence":"F R","position":"UF","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at UF with yellow pointing F: F then R lifts it via FR to UR yellow-up. Before executing, UR should not hold a yellow-up petal.","requiredFreeSlots":["UF","UR"],"affectedBottomSlots":["DR","DF"]}
criteria.flip-top-edge-left: {"id":"flip-top-edge-left","sequence":"F' L'","position":"UF","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at UF with yellow pointing F: F-prime then L-prime lifts it via FL to UL yellow-up. UL must be clear of existing petals.","requiredFreeSlots":["UF","UL"],"affectedBottomSlots":["DF","DL"]}
criteria.lower-top-edge: {"id":"lower-top-edge","sequence":"F","position":"UF","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at UF with yellow facing F, and the lift landing slots are occupied by petals: move it into FR first. criteria.cross-lift-right: {"id":"cross-lift-right","sequence":"R U R'","position":"FR","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at FR with yellow pointing F: lift it to UF yellow-up, preserving all bottom edges. criteria.cross-lift-left: {"id":"cross-lift-left","sequence":"L' U' L","position":"FL","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at FL with yellow pointing F: lift it to UF yellow-up, preserving all bottom edges. Use for extraction, not insertion.","requiredFreeSlots":["UB"],"affectedBottomSlots":[]}
criteria.cross-flip-top-right: {"id":"cross-flip-top-right","sequence":"F R U2 R' F'","position":"UF","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at UF with yellow pointing F: reorient it to UL yellow-up, preserving all bottom edges.","requiredFreeSlots":["UL","UF","UB"],"affectedBottomSlots":[]}
criteria.cross-flip-top-left: {"id":"cross-flip-top-left","sequence":"F' L' U2 L F","position":"UF","yellowDirection":"F","purpose":"Target at UF with yellow pointing F: reorient it to UR yellow-up, preserving all bottom edges.","requiredFreeSlots":["UR","UF","UB"],"affectedBottomSlots":[]}
